gloss_en: mas (מַס) — tribute / compulsory labor-service, as in Jacob's blessing 'va-yehi le-mas oved' (Gen 49:15), the tribute-bearing servant; homiletically linked by sound to מסמוס (dissolving/melting away)

outliers.actual_gloss_en: the letter-pair mem and samekh of the Tablets (which stood by miracle, Shabbat 104a), expounded as the aspect of forgetfulness
outliers.reason: Here מַס is not the word 'tribute' but the combination of the letters mem+samekh from the Talmudic dictum about the Tablets; a homograph of the biblical מַס of Gen 49:15.
